decisions.reason: As a flagship transactional email service shown on the home page, it meets aspirations in a growing market, and the firm's slack lets it keep investing in it.
A documented customer adoption shows results at or above aspiration, so there is no shortfall to trigger search for other uses of its resources.
The email-fax conversion service builds on the firm's core messaging infrastructure and is cheap to carry given the firm's slack, though declining fax demand adds some risk.

This small feature sits close to the established fax offer and costs little to maintain, so absent clear underperformance the firm would keep it, though it might be quietly absorbed into the core offer.
Sandbox threat protection is strategically central to the firm's email security portfolio and fits rising demand, so it likely meets aspirations, unlike the virus-scanning feature it already dropped.
